description: This file contains the implementation of concurrent and reentrant grains for Orleans, including methods for initialization, tail calls, and internal list modifications, used for testing concurrency and reentrancy features.

classes.name: ConcurrentGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing concurrent operations with initialization, method calls, and list modifications, including tail call mechanisms.

classes.name: ConcurrentReentrantGrain
classes.description: A reentrant grain supporting tail call operations with initialization and resolution methods.

methods.name: ConcurrentGrain.Constructor
methods.description: Initializes the grain with a logger.

methods.name: ConcurrentGrain.Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the grain with an index and creates child grains if index is zero.

methods.name: ConcurrentGrain.A
methods.description: Calls method B on child grains and logs the process.

methods.name: ConcurrentGrain.B
methods.description: Logs a call and simulates work with Thread.Sleep.

methods.name: ConcurrentGrain.ModifyReturnList_Test
methods.description: Modifies an internal list and returns it asynchronously.

methods.name: ConcurrentGrain.Initialize_2
methods.description: Re-initializes the grain with a new index.

methods.name: ConcurrentGrain.TailCall_Caller
methods.description: Performs a tail call to another grain, optionally with continuation.

methods.name: ConcurrentGrain.TailCall_Resolver
methods.description: Calls another grain to resolve a tail call.

methods.name: ConcurrentReentrantGrain.Constructor
methods.description: Initializes the reentrant grain with a logger.

methods.name: ConcurrentReentrantGrain.Initialize_2
methods.description: Initializes the reentrant grain with an index.

methods.name: ConcurrentReentrantGrain.TailCall_Called
methods.description: Begins a tail call, returning a task that will be completed later.

methods.name: ConcurrentReentrantGrain.TailCall_Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a tail call by setting the result.
